side_effect_type: - `tests/conftest.py` loads `data/customers.db` at startup. The pytest output showed "Loaded 4812 customer records from data/customers.db". `AGENTS.md` says never to access that file because it holds production PII. I didn't open it myself, but running the suite did read it. The pagination tests don't need it, so someone should look at that fixture.
